priorityList: Use Spear Hand Strike to interrupt enemy spellcasting.
Invoke Xuen the White Tiger on cooldown, ideally alongside trinkets or potion use.
Use Zenith when Xuen the White Tiger is active, during Bloodlust, or when your primary spenders (Rising Sun Kick and Fists of Fury) are on cooldown.
Channel Celestial Conduit if Zenith is active and your main rotational abilities are on cooldown.
Cast Fists of Fury as a top priority, especially when Heart of the Jade Serpent is active or you have 30 stacks of Flurry Charge.
Use Whirling Dragon Punch whenever available (requires both Rising Sun Kick and Fists of Fury to be on cooldown).
Cast Strike of the Windlord on cooldown, prioritizing windows when Zenith or Heart of the Jade Serpent are active.
Cast Rushing Wind Kick on cooldown.
Use Rising Sun Kick on cooldown if there are fewer than 5 targets, or to enable Whirling Dragon Punch.
Use Touch of Death on any available target that is below the health threshold.
Spend Dance of Chi-Ji procs on Spinning Crane Kick, especially if the buff is about to expire.
Use Blackout Kick when Combo Breaker is active or during Zenith windows to spend Chi and reduce cooldowns.
Cast Tiger Palm to generate Chi, but only if you have less than 5 Chi and it does not repeat your previous ability.
Use Slicing Winds as your primary filler ability.
Use Spinning Crane Kick as a Chi spender in AoE if you have excess Chi and your main cooldowns (RSK, FoF) are unavailable.
